entities.name: Kuberr

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Being whose birth caused the Fall of the Numena and who started Karona's War.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: Illusionist in whom Lowallyn was reincarnated.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Freed Ixidor and later Lowallyn from stone.

entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: War the Numena tried to stop.

entities.name: Fall of the Numena
entities.description: Event in which Lowallyn died after Karona's birth.

events.summary: Lowallyn imprisons Dromar the Banisher beneath the ocean by luring him to a treasure hoard.
events.quote: Lowallyn imprisoned the blue Primeval , Dromar the Banisher in a cavern deep beneath the ocean

events.summary: The birth of Karona causes the Fall of the Numena and Lowallyn's death.
events.quote: until the birth of Karona caused the Fall of the Numena and Lowallyn's death.

events.summary: Karona traps the Numena in a block of stone and Kuberr suffocates.
events.quote: Kuberr was left trapped inside too long and suffocated.

events.summary: Karona takes control of the magma giant Lowallyn made and has it stomp him to death.
events.quote: stomping Lowallyn to death with his massive burning foot

relations.quote: Lorwallyn was reincarnated as the illusionist Ixidor .

relations.note: Her control of the magma giant killed him.
relations.quote: Karona took control of the magma giant and turned it on his creator

relations.note: Freed him from the block of stone.
relations.quote: Lowallyn was freed by Kamahl and Stonebrow
